# GeoNames catalog fixture

The tests use only three GeoNames Russia populated-place rows and their minimal
preferred Russian/English alternate-name records: Ulyanovsk and two distinct
places named Kirov. The rows are transcribed from the 2026-08-29 GeoNames RU
country/alternate-name exports solely to exercise canonicalization and
same-name disambiguation.

Source: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/
